## 2024-07-04 - Missing Labels in Generated Scaffold Forms
**Learning:** Default ECR and Slang form templates generated by Amber's scaffold system for text and text_area fields do not include `<label>` tags. This creates an accessibility issue where screen readers cannot associate inputs with their names.
**Action:** When working on form scaffolding or modifying generated forms, explicitly add `label` helper calls (e.g., `<%= label(:field_name) %>` or `== label(:field_name)`) to ensure screen reader accessibility.
